question_text: During a police investigation, a suspect is subjected to electric shocks to force a confession. The suspect's lawyer argues that any evidence obtained from this treatment is inadmissible. Which of the following best supports the lawyer's argument?

options.text: RA 9745, the Anti-Torture Act, absolutely prohibits torture and declares any evidence obtained through torture inadmissible.
The Philippine Constitution only prohibits torture if it results in death or permanent injury.
RA 9165 allows the use of force in drug-related investigations.
The Rules of Court allow confessions obtained through duress if they are later corroborated.
